items.title: WattsOrbit v1.3.0
items.body:
## What's new

- **NewsBell** in the tray popup — unread dot and release notes dropdown
- **News screen** in the Dashboard with markdown rendering and pull-to-refresh
- **UpdaterModal** — changelog, download progress, in-app install
- **Homebrew Cask** auto-updates on every release

items.title: Keep the tray popup open
items.body: Hold ⌥ (Option) while clicking the menu-bar icon and the popup stays pinned — useful when you want to watch wattage drift while doing something else.
